- Key insight: "sample" Pearson = ordinary `np.corrcoef` r; the (n-1) vs n divisor cancels, so no special handling. Don't overthink the "sample" qualifier.
- Sanity check: these two yield series are near-perfectly correlated within any single year, so the abs diff of two yearly correlations is tiny (~1e-4); a large answer signals a wrong column or missing month.
- Don't pre-round the two correlations before taking the abs diff.

No memory update needed — the global delimiter/rounding rules already in memory cover the single-scalar 4-dp answer format, and this is a table/operation-specific pattern best kept in the skill reference.
